title: Layout
description: A vault's .peers/layout.json (ADR 0005): which folders and pages have their own agent, as path patterns. `*` matches within one path segment and `**` any depth; a pattern ending in a page extension (.md, .markdown, .org) matches pages, any other matches folders. PARA, one agent per top-level folder, and a wiki are presets.

agents.description: Folders and pages that get their own agent.

exclude.description: Exact paths a pattern would match that should not have an agent.

paused.description: Agents here do nothing on their own and do not answer for pages (an archive).

inbox.description: The folder or page the vault agent triages.

archive.description: Where "Move to archive" puts a folder or page.

readonly.description: Generated content agents must not edit.

hidden.description: Kept out of the tree; still searchable and readable by agents.

rules.description: Files with standing rules every agent follows.
